description: This file manages URL scanning tasks within a workflow system, including submitting URLs for scanning, polling for results, handling malicious URLs, and marking workflow steps as verified.

methods.name: sanitizeUrlForLogging
methods.description: Sanitizes a URL for logging by removing query parameters that may contain sensitive data.

methods.name: scanWorkflowUrls
methods.description: Main function to handle URL scanning workflow, including submission, polling, and handling malicious URLs.

methods.name: markWorkflowStepVerified
methods.description: Marks a workflow step as verified in the database.

methods.name: submitWorkflowStepForUrlScanning
methods.description: Extracts URLs from a workflow step body and initiates their scanning.

methods.name: submitUrlForUrlScanning
methods.description: Submits a single URL for scanning, typically used for redirect URLs.
